overview.body: This self-study resource explores RNA virus classification, entry, and replication.

learning_purpose.body: Learners discriminate virus families and inspect entry and replication systems.

knowledge_summary.body: RNA viruses differ by genome organisation, entry route, and replication strategy.

study_tips.body: Revisit the labelled figures after each activity.

activity_visual_value.rationale: Classification matrix supports virus-family typing before the analysis table.
Existing worked example already carries the needed structure.
Process visual makes HCV entry stages inspectable before sequencing.
System diagram externalises replication components and relationships.

visual_affordances.pedagogical_added_value: Adds discriminating genome and entry cues without revealing completed classifications.
visual_affordances.subject: RNA virus classification cues
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: compare RNA virus examples by genome organisation and entry-route discriminators so learners can classify before completing the analysis table; keep cells empty and avoid answer-key disclosure.
allowed_claims: RNA viruses differ by genome organisation and entry route.
disallowed_claims: All RNA viruses enter host cells identically.
visual_affordances.rationale: Makes discriminating genome and entry cues inspectable so learners can classify virus families before completing the analysis table.
visual_affordances.caption_intent: Classification cues only — not the learner table.
visual_affordances.alt_text: RNA virus classification cues by genome and entry route; detailed description follows.
visual_affordances.detailed_description: A classification matrix places RNA virus examples in rows against genome-organisation and entry-route cue columns. Labels name discriminating traits only; classification cells remain empty so learners assign virus families themselves without an answer key.

visual_affordances.pedagogical_added_value: Makes ordered entry stages inspectable without completing the learner sequence answers.
visual_affordances.subject: HCV entry pathway stages
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: show receptor attachment, internalization, membrane fusion, and RNA release as an ordered inspectable sequence before learners complete the sequencing task; do not reveal worked answers.
allowed_claims: HCV entry proceeds through ordered attachment-to-release stages.
visual_affordances.rationale: Makes the HCV entry sequence inspectable so learners can reason about stage order before completing the sequencing task.
visual_affordances.alt_text: HCV entry pathway from receptor attachment to RNA release; detailed description follows.
visual_affordances.detailed_description: An ordered pathway shows HCV progressing from receptor attachment through internalization and membrane fusion to cytosolic RNA release. Arrows mark sequence direction; stage labels name each process without claiming timing certainty beyond the brief.
visual_affordances.reasoning_supported: Learners inspect process structure before completing sequence reasoning.
visual_affordances.canonical_discipline_note: Show stages as inspectable structure, not answered worksheet.

visual_affordances.pedagogical_added_value: Externalises replication components and relationships without duplicating the worksheet.
visual_affordances.subject: HCV replication system components
visual_affordances.context: Visual brief: show replication complex components and directional relationships among RNA synthesis, protein processing, and assembly so learners can inspect the system before completing analysis; exclude unsupported quantitative claims.
allowed_claims: HCV replication links RNA synthesis, processing, and assembly.
disallowed_claims: Exact kinetic rates not present in source materials.
visual_affordances.rationale: Externalises the replication system so learners can inspect component relationships before completing the analysis task, reducing avoidable working-memory load.
visual_affordances.alt_text: HCV replication system linking RNA synthesis, processing, and assembly; detailed description follows.
visual_affordances.detailed_description: An annotated system diagram links RNA synthesis, protein processing, and particle assembly. Directional relationships show how synthesised RNA and processed proteins feed assembly. Labels name components and relationships only; no kinetic rates or completed analysis answers appear.
visual_affordances.reasoning_supported: Learners inspect system relationships before analysis conclusions.
visual_affordances.canonical_discipline_note: Use only source-supported components and links.

activities.learner_task: Classify RNA virus examples using genome and entry cues.
